description: Discard (delete) a never-published OpenTrain job draft so it no longer appears in the job list. Only drafts that were never published, have no proposals and are in no folder can be discarded, and only by an organization owner; a published job is closed with opentrain_close_job instead. Pass confirm=true. Idempotent: a repeat call reports alreadyDiscarded. Requires jobs:write scope and the job-drafting feature.

confirm.description: Must be true: discarding deletes the draft and removes it from the job list.

jobId.description: Never-published OpenTrain draft id to discard.

name: opentrain_discard_job_draft
